title: Role of community mental health services in Singapore's care continuum
asked: Dr Hamid Razak asked how the Ministry defines the intended role of community mental health services, whether they are designed as first-contact services, post-hospital step-down care or both, and how that shapes service design and resourcing.
response: Dr Koh Poh Koon said community mental health teams comprise Community Outreach Teams (CREST) and Community Intervention Teams (COMIT). CREST is a designated First Stop for Mental Health for screening, basic emotional support and mental health resources, while COMIT provides higher-level psychosocial interventions such as cognitive behavioural therapy for people with moderate mental health needs. Both also take patients referred for follow-up after acute hospital treatment, so they serve as both a first stop and community follow-up. MOH and the Agency for Integrated Care monitor clinical and functional outcomes, service utilisation, intensity of care needs and referral sources, and use this data to review and refine services and determine resourcing.

key_points.point: Community mental health teams are CREST and COMIT
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: Community mental health teams include Community Outreach Teams (CREST) and Community Intervention Teams (COMIT).

key_points.point: CREST is designated as a First Stop for Mental Health, covering screening, basic emotional support and other mental health resources
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: CREST is designated as one of the First Stops for Mental Health to improve access to screening, basic emotional support and other mental health resources.

key_points.point: COMIT provides higher-level psychosocial interventions, such as cognitive behavioural therapy, for moderate mental health needs
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: COMIT provides higher level psychosocial interventions, such as cognitive behavioural therapy, for individuals with moderate mental health needs.

key_points.point: Both CREST and COMIT also take patients referred for follow-up after acute hospital treatment
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: Both CREST and COMIT attend to patients referred for follow-up after undergoing treatment at the acute hospitals.

key_points.point: The services are intended to serve as both a first stop and community follow-up
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: both these resources are to cater as a first stop and also, for follow-up in the community

key_points.point: Outcomes are tracked using the Patient Health Questionnaire, Generalised Anxiety Disorder and the WHO Disability Assessment Schedule 2.0
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: clinical and functional outcomes using tools such as the Patient Health Questionnaire, Generalised Anxiety Disorder and the World Health Organization Disability Assessment Schedule 2.0

key_points.point: Service utilisation, intensity of care needs and referral sources are also monitored
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: We also monitor the service utilisation and intensity of care needs of clients, including the referral sources.

key_points.point: This data is used to review and refine services and to determine resourcing
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: We use such data in our ongoing review and refinement of community mental health services, and to determine the resourcing for these services.

key_points.point: Training resources and pocket guides are being pushed out to help care providers right-site clients to the right level of care
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: one of our measures is to push forth training resources and having some pocket guides to help the care providers right-site the clients to the right level of care

key_points.point: Extra support to community partners could take the form of funding or training support
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: It could be funding, could be training support to be able to deliver the services that they need to do in the community.

left_open: Specific staffing numbers or ratios for community mental health workers
supplementary: Supplementary questions focused on whether community mental health workers are adequately resourced and staffed.
